baseline.selection: Five most recent merged PRs represented on baseline main first-parent history, descending merge time; not mutable updated_at sort.

measurement.rename_handling: Git default rename detection; renamed files count once using destination path; previous_path is retained.
measurement.binary_handling: Binary rows retain null line counts and count as changed files/binary files; added/deleted line totals exclude binary bytes.
measurement.line_stat_completeness: All five Git numstat file/addition/deletion totals exactly match frozen GitHub PR metadata. GitHub files endpoint underreports PR60/63 line stats despite complete filenames; do not use those line totals.
measurement.effort_limit: Changed files/lines, workflow records and latest attempt indices are observations, not elapsed work, cost, time savings or causes.
measurement.category_limit: Path categories separate editing owners from renditions. Validation/scanner/test changes are not assumed unnecessary harness overhead. Task evidence includes maintained narrative and captured/generated records; no blanket generated classification.
measurement.verification: All frozen numstat destination-path inventories equal complete paginated GitHub filenames; total files/additions/deletions equal GitHub PR metadata for every sampled PR.

workflow_query.selection: Observed pull_request runs in the three fetched pages with exact PR head_branch and created_at <= that PR merged_at. Results include historical force-pushed/rebased heads. Deduplicate IDs. This is bounded API evidence, not an assertion of all workflow events or deleted runs.
workflow_query.attempt_limit: run_attempt is GitHub's latest attempt index for one run, not a complete attempt history; current conclusions do not establish each prior attempt's result.

F08.causal_limit: The data do not isolate the effect of exact-source binding or PR size. Different commits, manual triggers, failed assertions, source changes, rebases, skipped diagnostic workflows and external gates coexist. Retain exact-source binding required by I2; proposing scoped evidence reuse requires unchanged owner/artifact proof.

F09.observation: Initial issue61/PR63 task was a PMDay recording update; final PR63 also removes active Color ribbons and changes runtime/tests/scanner evidence. Final diff cannot quantify pure content overhead.
F09.sample_limit: No final merged PR in the five-PR sample is a small content-only change. Initial PR63 commit46d343 is a separate illustrative checkpoint, not a sixth PR or final-scope ratio.
F09.causal_limit: Diff ratios and repeated runs do not measure task time or prove procedural causes.
